description: This Java class 'DefaultEntityExportService' implements entity export functionality for the Thingsboard platform, including exporting entity data, relations, attributes, and calculated fields, with support for external ID mapping.

classes.name: DefaultEntityExportService
classes.description: Service class for exporting entity data, relations, attributes, and calculated fields with external ID mapping support.

methods.name: getExportData
methods.description: Retrieves export data for a given entity ID, including setting additional data and handling external IDs.

methods.name: setAdditionalExportData
methods.description: Adds relations, attributes, and calculated fields to the export data based on export settings.

methods.name: exportRelations
methods.description: Fetches inbound and outbound relations for an entity.

methods.name: exportAttributes
methods.description: Exports attributes of an entity within specified scopes.

methods.name: exportCalculatedFields
methods.description: Exports calculated fields associated with an entity, resolving references.

methods.name: getExternalIdOrElseInternal
methods.description: Maps internal entity IDs to external IDs, caching results.

methods.name: getExternalIdOrElseInternalByUuid
methods.description: Converts UUIDs to external IDs, attempting multiple entity types.
